agenda_text:
HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  Thursday, September 3, 2026
  5:30 p.m., Room 104, first floor
  Community Services Building - 150 N. Third Street

This agenda contains a summary of each item of business that the Heritage Commission may
discuss or act on at this meeting. The staff report and all other documentation relating to each
agenda item are on file and available for public inspection in the office of the Community
Development Department.  Staff reports are also available on the internet at
www.burbankca.gov/planning. If you have questions or comments about any agenda item, please
call the Planning Division at (818) 238-5250.

This facility is disabled accessible. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act,
if any special assistance is needed to participate in this meeting, please contact the ADA
Coordinator at (818) 238-5051 voice or (818) 238-5035 TDD. Notification 48 hours in
advance of this meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements for special
assistance.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Heritage Commission Meeting will be held on Thursday,
September 3, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. at the Community Services Building, 150 N. Third Street, 1st
Floor, Room 104, Burbank, to discuss matters on the attached agenda.

Interpretation Requests:
If you would like to participate in Public Comments and require an interpreter, please telephone
the City Clerk’s Office at (818) 238-5851 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

Si desea participar en los comentarios públicos y necesita un intérprete, por favor llame a la
Oficina de la Secretaria Municipal al (818) 238-5851 al menos 48 horas antes de la reunión.

Եթե ցանկանում եք մասնակցել հանրային մեկնաբանություններին և թարգմանիչ եք
պահանջում, խնդրում ենք զանգահարել քաղաքապետարանի գրասենյակ՝ (818) 238-5851
հեռախոսահամարով հանդիպումից 48 ժամ առաջ:

Public Comment Options:
To speak during Public Comment, members of the public may speak for five minutes in-person at
the Community Services Building First Floor Meeting Room 104 or via web conference. In order
to comment via web conference, you must contact the Planning Division at (818) 238-5250 by
noon on Thursday, September 3, 2026, in order to receive a link or call-in number. Members of
the public who attend in person will speak first, followed by any remote participants.

B. ROLL CALL

C. ANNOUNCEMENTS
  1. Welcome to New Heritage Commissioners – Laura Strobl and Zach Martin.

D. PUBLIC COMMUNICATION ON AGENDA ITEMS (LIMIT 5 MINUTES)
At this time, any person may address the Commission on agenda items.

E. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  1. June 6, 2026

F. ITEMS
  1. Presentation: Library Services Director Eric Lashley will provide a presentation to the
  Heritage Commission on the upcoming Civic Center Library Project.

  2. 4211 West Riverside Drive: Staff will provide an update to the Heritage Commission on
  the ongoing Code Enforcement Case at Bob’s Big Boy regarding the outdoor patio
  covering.

G. STAFF COMMUNICATION
  1. 902 East Olive Avenue “The Rock House” - New Owners.

  2. Update on Communication with the Fernandeño Tataviam Band of Mission Indians.

H. COMMISSIONER COMMUNICATION

I. PUBLIC COMMUNICATION ON NON AGENDA ITEMS (LIMIT 5 MINUTES)
At this time, any person may address the Commission on non-agenda items.

J. TENTATIVE AGENDA ITEMS FOR NEXT MEETING

  1. Election of Chair and Vice Chair: The Heritage Commission will vote to select one member
  to serve as Chair and one member to serve as Vice-Chair for a one year term.

  ADJOURNMENT TO THE HERITAGE COMMISSION MEETING OF OCTOBER 1, 2026
  5:30 P.M., AT ROOM 101, FIRST FLOOR, COMMUNITY SERVICES BUILDING,
  150 N. THIRD STREET.

It is the Mission of the Burbank Heritage Commission to actively promote the appreciation and
preservation of Burbank's historical and cultural resources and advance the understanding and
practice of historic preservation through designations of historic homes, structures, locations,
districts, and educational outreach. The Heritage Commission also acts in an advisory role to the
City Council and Planning Commission on all matters pertaining to historic preservation.
